Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
int main() {
string s , d;
 cin>>s>>d;
 transform(s.begin(),s.end() , s.begin(),::toupper);
 transform(d.begin(),d.end() , d.begin(),::toupper);
 string arrs[8] = {"TH" , "GA", "IC" , "HA" , "TE", "LU" ,"NI","CA"};
 float arr[8]={800,600,750,900,1400,1200,1100,1500};
 float res=0;
 int st ,ed;
 for(int i=0;i<8;i++)
 {
     if(s==arrs[i])
     st=i;
     
     if(d==arrs[i])
     ed=i;
  }
  if(st==ed)
  {
      cout<<" INVALID INPUT";
      return 0;
  }
  else
  {
      int i=st+1;
      cout<<i;
        while(i!=ed+1)
        {
            res+=(arr[i]);
            i=(i+1)%8;
        }
        cout<<(ceil)(res*0.005);
        return 0;
 }
}
